nodes.label: Boost.ts
nodes.description: Defines the damage boost calculation system for the Voxel Blade build calculator. Contains BoostDef/BoostContext interfaces and a comprehensive BOOST_DEFS array of 30+ damage boosts (Blood Thirsty, Frenzy, Primal, Penance, Vampire, etc.), each with either simple multiplier-per-perk values or complex custom calcFn closures. Also exports helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct, and Penance bleed constants.

nodes.label: calcMinionAbsorptionPotency
nodes.description: Calculates the potency of Minion Absorption based on summon boost percentage and stack count. Returns a rounded decimal representing the damage boost multiplier.

nodes.label: calcFrenzyPct
nodes.description: Calculates the Frenzy damage percentage by combining the base frenzy value with a rage-potency-scaled multiplier.

nodes.label: PENANCE_HP_THRESHOLD
nodes.description: HP threshold (35%) at which Penance reaches max boost and triggers bleed.

nodes.label: PENANCE_MAX_BOOST
nodes.description: Maximum damage boost from Penance (25%).

nodes.label: PENANCE_BLEED_POTENCY
nodes.description: Potency of the Penance bleed effect (0 = status-only, no damage).

nodes.label: PENANCE_BLEED_DURATION
nodes.description: Duration in seconds of the Penance bleed (5s).

nodes.label: BoostContext
nodes.description: Context object passed to complex boost calcFn functions. Contains player state (perks, crit chance, jump boost, rage potency, HP fill, enemy HP, etc.) needed to evaluate conditional boosts.

nodes.label: BoostDef
nodes.description: Definition structure for a damage boost. Supports simple multiplierPerPerk boosts, complex calcFn-based boosts, attack-type filtering (appliesTo), proc coefficient scaling, and user-facing toggles.

nodes.label: BOOST_DEFS
nodes.description: Array of all 30+ damage boost definitions. Each entry describes a boost source (perk name, level, etc.), its type (dmg/heal), how it scales, conditions, and attack-type applicability.

nodes.label: BOOST_DEF_MAP
nodes.description: Map<string, BoostDef> for O(1) lookup of boost definitions by source name.

nodes.label: debuffCombatEffects.ts
nodes.description: Defines the combat effects applied by debuffs on enemies. Exports a DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS record mapping debuff names (Weakness, Shatter, Sticky variants, Electrical Rend, Despair, Frostbite, Hypnotized) to DebuffCombatEffect objects containing description generators, damage multipliers, defense reductions, and element-specific damage multipliers.

nodes.label: DebuffCombatEffect
nodes.description: Structure defining a debuff's combat impact: a description function, optional damage multiplier, optional defense reduction across 8 stat types, and optional element-specific damage multipliers.

nodes.label: DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS
nodes.description: Record<string, DebuffCombatEffect> mapping 9 debuff names to their combat effect definitions. Covers Weakness, Shatter, Sticky (4 variants), Electrical Rend, Despair, Frostbite, and Hypnotized.

nodes.label: enemyHpEffects.ts
nodes.description: Defines HP-gated enemy effects that trigger based on enemy current HP percentage. Contains interfaces for HP gates, debuff effects, and DoT boosts, plus a static ENEMY_HP_EFFECT_DEFS array (currently Mycotic Bloom). Exports functions getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs and getEnemyHpDotMultiplier to evaluate which effects are active given the current enemy HP and active debuffs.

nodes.label: EnemyHpGate
nodes.description: HP threshold gate: hpThreshold (percentage) and aboveThreshold (above or below).

nodes.label: EnemyHpDebuffEffect
nodes.description: Defines a debuff that gets applied based on enemy HP gate: buffName, potency function, and duration.

nodes.label: EnemyHpDotBoost
nodes.description: Defines a DoT damage multiplier based on enemy HP gate: dotType and getMultiplier function.

nodes.label: EnemyHpEffectDef
nodes.description: Complete definition of an enemy HP-gated effect: perk name, condition description, HP gate, optional required debuff, optional debuff grant, optional DoT boost.

nodes.label: getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs
nodes.description: Evaluates all ENEMY_HP_EFFECT_DEFS and returns debuffs whose HP gates and prerequisite debuffs are met given current perks, enemy HP, and active debuffs.
nodes.signature: (perks: Record<string, number>, enemyHpFillPct: number, activeDebuffNames: string[]) => Array<{ buffName, potency, duration, condition, sourceName }>

nodes.label: getEnemyHpDotMultiplier
nodes.description: Returns the cumulative DoT damage multiplier from all active enemy HP-gated dot boosts for a given dot type.
nodes.signature: (perks: Record<string, number>, enemyHpFillPct: number, dotType: string) => number

nodes.label: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
nodes.description: Determines which debuffs are automatically applied by perks during combat. Contains calcActualHpFillPct for effective HP calculation accounting for protection, and getAutoDebuffs which evaluates 16+ perk conditions (Exhaust, Penance, Melting Shred, Fungal Prototype, Venom Spitter, Toxin Caster, Gorecast, Splinter, Bellowing Ember, Frostbite, Gelid Lance, Weakening, Sunburn, Fiery Pursuit, Pyre Bloom, Hypnotist) to produce GrantedBuff arrays.

nodes.label: AutoDebuffInput
nodes.description: Input parameters for getAutoDebuffs: existing buffs, player perks, HP fill, level, protection, WA proc coefficient, enemy HP, and damage type flags.

nodes.label: calcActualHpFillPct
nodes.description: Calculates effective HP fill percentage accounting for negative protection (armor reduction that reduces max HP). Returns clamped value at 100%.
nodes.signature: (hpFill: number, level: number, protection: number) => number

nodes.label: getAutoDebuffs
nodes.description: Main auto-debuff evaluation function. Checks 16+ perk conditions against current game state and returns an array of GrantedBuff objects representing debuffs to apply to the enemy. Handles HP-gated debuffs, element-gated debuffs, proc-gated debuffs, and mutual exclusion (won't re-apply existing debuffs).

nodes.label: debuff-effects.ts
nodes.description: Small constants file defining numeric multipliers used by debuff combat effects. Contains the Sticky damage multiplier (1.2x), Despair display divisor/coefficient for UI formatting, and Despair damage coefficient (0.085).

nodes.label: DEBUFF_STICKY_DMG_MULT
nodes.description: Damage multiplier applied to targets affected by Sticky debuff (1.2 = +20% damage taken).

nodes.label: DEBUFF_DESPAIR_DISPLAY_DIVISOR
nodes.description: Divisor used to convert raw Despair potency to display percentage.

nodes.label: DEBUFF_DESPAIR_DISPLAY_MULT
nodes.description: Multiplier used in Despair UI display calculations.

nodes.label: DEBUFF_DESPAIR_DMG_COEFF
nodes.description: Damage coefficient for Despair debuff (0.085). Multiplied by potency/display-divisor to get actual damage boost.

nodes.label: game.ts
nodes.description: Core game constants serving as the single source of truth for game-wide values. Defines level caps (MAX_LEVEL=80, DEFAULT_LEVEL=80), HP formula constants (BASE_HP=120, HP_PER_LEVEL=0.0125) with calcBaseMaxHP function, default fill percentages, and timing constants for UI operations (save debounce, undo window, search blur delay, toast duration, etc.).

nodes.label: MAX_LEVEL
nodes.description: Maximum character level (80).

nodes.label: DEFAULT_LEVEL
nodes.description: Default character level used in the calculator (80).

nodes.label: DEFAULT_HP_FILL
nodes.description: Default HP fill percentage (100%).

nodes.label: DEFAULT_ENEMY_HP_FILL
nodes.description: Default enemy HP fill percentage (100%).

nodes.label: BASE_HP
nodes.description: Base max HP at level 0 (120).

nodes.label: HP_PER_LEVEL
nodes.description: HP scaling per level (1.25% per level, stored as 0.0125).

nodes.label: calcBaseMaxHP
nodes.description: Calculates base max HP for a given level using the formula: BASE_HP * (1 + level * HP_PER_LEVEL).

nodes.label: SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS
nodes.description: Debounce delay for auto-saving build state (300ms).

nodes.label: UNDO_WINDOW_MS
nodes.description: Time window for undo operations (8000ms).

nodes.label: SEARCH_BLUR_DELAY_MS
nodes.description: Delay before search input loses focus (150ms).

nodes.label: IMPORT_SUCCESS_DISPLAY_MS
nodes.description: Duration to show import success message (2000ms).

nodes.label: FOCUS_DELAY_MS
nodes.description: Delay before focusing an element (20ms).

nodes.label: DEFAULT_TOAST_DURATION_MS
nodes.description: Default toast notification duration (3000ms).

nodes.label: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.description: Contains raw numeric base damage values for all perk-triggered abilities, weapon arts, and spirit summons. Organized by ability name (Dragon Claw, Dragon Bubble, Springblast, various Spirits, Honey Arts, Melting Slime, Pyre Bloom, Bastion Ballista, etc.). Each ability has base damage, per-stack scaling, and optionally special properties (healing, poise damage, duration, ammo, cooldown).

nodes.label: perks.ts
nodes.description: Contains perk-specific numeric constants used across the damage engine. Covers crit base values (BASE_CRIT_DAMAGE=150), crit rate multipliers for various perks (Flowing Crits, Spell Slinger, Sharp Crits, etc.), crit damage formulas (Thief Training, Venom Eater, Vital Strikes, etc.), element multipliers (Luminescent, Spirit Winds, Dark Magic, etc.), and combat mechanic values (Sunburn, Frostbite, Fiery Pursuit, Hypnotist, Phantom Pain).

nodes.label: LUMINESCENT_PCT_PER_STACK
nodes.description: Luminescent damage percentage per stack (5%).

nodes.label: SPIRIT_WINDS_PCT_PER_STACK
nodes.description: Spirit Winds damage percentage per stack (10%).

nodes.label: DARK_MAGIC_PCT_PER_STACK
nodes.description: Dark Magic damage percentage per stack (20%).

nodes.label: BASE_CRIT_DAMAGE
nodes.description: Base critical hit damage multiplier (150%).

nodes.label: DEX_CRIT_DIVISOR
nodes.description: Divisor for Dexterity-based crit chance calculation.

nodes.label: FROSTBITE_SLOW_POTENCY_PER_STACK
nodes.description: Slowness potency applied by Frostbite per perk stack.

nodes.label: FROSTBITE_CHANCE_PER_STACK
nodes.description: Proc chance for Frostbite slow per perk stack.

nodes.label: SUNBURN_BURN_BASE_CHANCE
nodes.description: Base chance for Sunburn to apply Burn (24%).

nodes.label: SUNBURN_BURN_CHANCE_PER_STACK
nodes.description: Additional Burn chance per Sunburn stack (6%).

nodes.label: FIERY_PURSUIT_BURN_DURATION
nodes.description: Duration of Burn applied by Fiery Pursuit (5s).

nodes.label: HYPNOTIST_POTENCY_PER_PERK
nodes.description: Hypnotized debuff potency per perk point.

nodes.label: HYPNOTIST_DURATION_BASE
nodes.description: Base duration of Hypnotized debuff (10s).

nodes.label: HYPNOTIST_DURATION_PER_PERK
nodes.description: Additional Hypnotized duration per perk point (5s).

nodes.label: HYPNOTIST_MAGIC_ARMOR_PER_POTENCY
nodes.description: Magic armor reduction per point of Hypnotized potency (50).

nodes.label: storage.ts
nodes.description: Defines localStorage keys and serialization mappings for build state persistence. Contains STORAGE_KEY_* constants for each saved data category, BUILD_STATE_DEFAULTS record with all default build values, SAVE_KEY_MAP/UNMAP for compact save serialization, and ENCH_MAP/UNMAP for enchantment serialization. Also defines MAX_BUILD_SLOTS (5) and CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS.

nodes.label: STORAGE_KEY_BUILD
nodes.description: localStorage key for build state: 'voxlbuilder_build_v1'.

nodes.label: STORAGE_KEY_DEFENSES
nodes.description: localStorage key for defense stats: 'voxlbuilder_defenses_v1'.

nodes.label: STORAGE_KEY_LEVEL
nodes.description: localStorage key for character level: 'voxlbuilder_level'.

nodes.label: STORAGE_KEY_HP_FILL
nodes.description: localStorage key for HP fill percentage: 'voxlbuilder_hpfill'.

nodes.label: STORAGE_KEY_SAVES
nodes.description: localStorage key for saved builds: 'voxlbuilder_saves'.

nodes.label: BUILD_STATE_DEFAULTS
nodes.description: Record of default values for all build state fields including equipment slots, upgrades, weapon art, racial/guild settings, HP fill, level, summon count, and UI toggles.

nodes.label: SAVE_KEY_MAP
nodes.description: Maps full build state property names to compact 2-3 character keys for URL/save serialization.

nodes.label: SAVE_KEY_UNMAP
nodes.description: Reverse mapping from compact save keys back to full property names.

nodes.label: ENCH_MAP
nodes.description: Maps equipment slot names to compact enchantment serialization keys.

nodes.label: ENCH_UNMAP
nodes.description: Reverse mapping from compact enchantment keys to equipment slot names.

nodes.label: MAX_BUILD_SLOTS
nodes.description: Maximum number of build save slots (5).

nodes.label: CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS
nodes.description: Timeout for confirmation dialogs (3000ms).

nodes.label: dmgTypeBonuses.ts
nodes.description: Engine module that calculates elemental/magical damage type bonuses from perks. Defines PerkDmgTypeBonusDef interface and PERK_DMG_TYPE_BONUS_DEFS array (Void Rage → hex, Channeled Weapon → magic, Emotional → fire, Draconic Blood → dynamic based on draconic color). The buildDmgTypeBonuses function evaluates all definitions against current player state and returns a Record<string, number> of damage type to bonus percentage, also accounting for Toxin Transfer hex bonus.

nodes.label: PerkDmgTypeBonusDef
nodes.description: Definition for a perk that grants bonus damage of a specific element type. Supports fixed or dynamic type, fixed or computed amount-per-stack, conditional activation, and proc exemption.

nodes.label: PERK_DMG_TYPE_BONUS_DEFS
nodes.description: Array of 4 perk damage type bonus definitions: Void Rage (hex, conditional on rage), Channeled Weapon (magic), Emotional (fire, conditional on debuffs state), Draconic Blood (dynamic type, conditional on draconic infusion).

nodes.label: buildDmgTypeBonuses
nodes.description: Evaluates all PERK_DMG_TYPE_BONUS_DEFS against current player state, accumulates damage type bonuses into a Record<string, number>, handles Draconic Blood dynamic typing and Toxin Transfer hex bonus injection. Supports exclusion of specific perks and no-proc exemption filtering.
nodes.signature: (includeNoProcExempt: boolean, ctx: { perks, ragePotency, draconicRuneInfusion, emotionalState, draconicColor, guild, draconicInfusionDisabled, toxinTransferHexBonus, rageDisabled }, excludePerks?: Set<string>) => Record<string, number>
